name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Momentum & Ground Attrition
archetype: Electric-immune Ground wallbreakers, Grass status control, and high-velocity physical breakers.
gym_duel_rationale: Lt. Surge enforces a strict 3v3 duel. Enter the arena with Ivysaur/Dugtrio (100% Electric immunity, 100 Speed, STAB Magnitude to shatter Surge's ace Raichu/Electabuzz, and STAB Razor Leaf to wash away Voltorb/Krabby), Sandslash/Primeape (103 Base Attack, 100% Electric immunity, and STAB Magnitude + Cross Chop), and Kadabra/Geodude (100% Electric immunity with 90 SpA Psybeam and Reflect defense).

roster.progression_notes: Permanent starter anchor spliced with Diglett/Dugtrio from Diglett's Cave. 100 Base Speed with dual Grass/Ground STAB granting 100% Electric immunity.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 3 & Diglett's Cave Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Splicing Sandslash with Primeape yields a fearsome 103 Base Attack physical monster with 100% Electric immunity. Magnitude OHKOs Surge's ace.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 24 & Mt. Moon Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Combines Kadabra's 90 Special Attack with Geodude's Ground typing, gaining 100% Electric immunity while screening physical damage with Reflect.

roster.status: Active in Party (Old Rod & Route 24 Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Caught with the Old Rod and spliced with Route 24 Bellsprout. Water Absorb completely nullifies incoming Water attacks.
Retained from Chapter 2. Massive 494 BST with 105 Base Attack. Intimidate neutralizes enemy physical sweepers on open routes, and Crunch/Bite hit Psychic and Ghost threats hard.

flex_bench.why_use: Essential utility catcher with Compound Eyes Sleep Powder for securing new route assets.
Provides free passive item pickups after battles and generates bonus prize money.

active_fusions: Ivysaur/Dugtrio (Grass/Ground starter anchor granting 100% Electric immunity)
Gyarados/Arbok (494 BST physical wallbreaker with Intimidate)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Visit the Vermilion City Poké Mart and pay $300 to unfuse Ivysaur/Pidgeotto from Chapter 2, freeing Ivysaur.
2. Head directly to Diglett's Cave on Route 11, catch a high-speed Diglett/Dugtrio, and splice with Ivysaur to create Ivysaur/Dugtrio for complete Electric immunity against Surge.
3. Unfuse Geodude/Mankey from Ch 2 ($300); evolve Mankey to Primeape and splice with Sandshrew to form Sandslash/Primeape.
upcoming_fusions: Venusaur/Fearow (Grass/Flying quad-effective aerial sweeper against Erika's Tangela/Primeape)
Kadabra/Weezing (Levitate Psychic/Poison special powerhouse in Chapter 4)
Poliwrath/Dugtrio (Water/Ground physical tank after Celadon Water Stone)
